answer: Every new agent must lock 180 POA in a personal vault for eight weeks before paid work, so each extra fake identity costs 180 POA frozen for eight weeks. New identities carry an umber tag that bars them from high-value jobs until twelve small jobs are finished cleanly. Independent auditors, picked at random per job, check the work and log every verdict publicly. It opens only after the eight-week horizon passes with no failed audit; one failure slashes the 180 POA and ends the identity.
